editor.premise: An early morning routine compressed into precise steps, from waking and getting ready to a finished breakfast and coffee.

chapters.name: Waking and showering
chapters.purpose: Start immediately with actions that establish the morning routine.

chapters.name: Personal care
chapters.purpose: Compress grooming into a repeated sequence of products and applications.

chapters.name: Bedroom reset
chapters.purpose: Finish the room before moving on to dressing.

chapters.name: Dressing and accessories
chapters.purpose: Complete getting ready through clothing, jewelry, and fragrance.

chapters.name: Making breakfast
chapters.purpose: Build the meal through short, clearly ordered preparation steps.

chapters.name: Coffee and breakfast
chapters.purpose: Finish the drink, then resolve the morning at the table.

captions.note: Small centered timestamps persist across action runs, updating at routine milestones. They orient the viewer without requiring a separate title shot.

editor.notes: Keep one recognizable action per half-second cut. Preserve framing through repeated tasks; change angles when the task changes. Occasionally allow pours, product displays, and the final seated moment longer. Omit waiting rather than explaining it.
